title: Suka Hides It
summary: Suka hides her dad's things, and Dad searches and searches. Why is she doing it?
pages:
Suka thinks, "What fun, what a delight!"
She takes the shampoo and puts it on the shelf, out of sight.
"Shhhh..."

Dad comes to wash — but what's this?
The shampoo? It was right here!
He looks here, he looks there —
"Where? Where? Where?"

Suka laughs without a sound, and now she grabs
Dad's pants with both hands,
and puts them on the chair —
"Shhhh..."

Dad searches: "They were right here!"
He looks here, he looks there —
"Where? Where? Where?"

And the hat? The hat too!
Suka stands up on her tiptoes,
and puts it on the shelf, way up high —
"Shhhh..."

Dad scratches his head: "It was right here!"
No shampoo, no pants, no hat anywhere —
"Where? Where? Where?"

Then Dad stops searching.
He looks at Suka.
Suka looks at the ceiling.
Suka is quiet. And quiet. And quiet.

And suddenly — hooray! — Suka bursts into a dance:
shampoo in one hand, pants in the other!
"Here it all is! Here it all is!"
And Dad claps his hands: "Hooray! Hooray! Hooray!"

And tomorrow? Who knows?
Maybe the pink teddy bear will go missing...
"Shhhh... I didn't say a thing."
